correctness.rationale: The rim-plus-leaf local parity condition yields weights one for backtracking rim triples and q-3 for nonbacktracking ones. Trace of a complete ordered-pair transfer is counted exactly. Its invariant subspaces have dimensions 1, 2(q-1), q(q-3)/2, (q-1)(q-2)/2, which exhaust q(q-1). An exact two-root recurrence gives the displayed polynomial for all q>=3, then polynomial identity covers q=0,1,2. The original-condition enumerator and an independent exact transfer algorithm were both executed, passing 11 and 84 finite cases respectively. Finite tests support but do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: The all-palette polynomial refines a newly studied graph-coloring invariant on a natural unicyclic family. It gives a complete count of valid named assignments, a nontrivial finite-spectrum recurrence, exact optimizer enumeration with a sharp parity distinction, and fixed-palette exponential asymptotics. These data are not recovered from a scalar 4-color upper bound and motivate study of other corona families.
